verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships a first-party `vastai` agent skill that lets AI coding assistants drive the platform on the user's behalf: creating instances, deploying endpoints, managing SSH keys and checking balances. The natural-language layer itself comes from an external coding agent, and there is no evidence of a built-in natural-language interface in the console or CLI. missing for 10: native natural-language interface within the product, documentation of the skill's full command coverage and limits, independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The `vastai` agent skill lets AI coding assistants drive Vast.ai on your behalf — create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys, check balances, and more
Install the skill into your coding agent with one command: npx skills add vast-ai/vast-cli --skill vastai
